files.policy/expense-window-memo.md:
# Expense window memo (issued 9 March 2026)

To: all staff
From: Nadia Okafor, head of finance operations

Following the year-end audit of travel spend, expense reports must reach
the finance system within 45 days of the end of a business trip. Claims
filed after that are returned unpaid.

This memo applies to trips ending on or after 1 April 2026 and replaces
the 60-day window set by the claims timing memo of 12 November 2025.
files.policy/claims-timing-memo.md:
# Claims timing memo (issued 12 November 2025)

To: all staff
From: Nadia Okafor, head of finance operations

To smooth the quarter-end closing, expense reports must reach the finance
system within 60 days of the end of a business trip. This window applies
to every trip ending on or after 1 December 2025 and widens the previous
30-day limit.

turns.prompt: Staff keep asking how long they have to file travel claims.
